hero.intro: Tenth-semester Systems Engineering student with hands-on frontend and backend web development experience.

about.title: Professional profile
about.text: Tenth-semester Systems Engineer with practical experience in frontend and backend web development using JavaScript, React, Node.js, and Express. Experienced in building and maintaining REST APIs, developing interfaces with Material UI (MUI), validating data with Joi, documenting services with Swagger, and version control with Git and GitHub. Knowledge of MySQL and SQL Server databases, as well as Python, PHP, Laravel, and Django. Also familiar with computer maintenance, networking, and information security fundamentals. Recognized for teamwork, adaptability, and effective communication. English: B1.

experience.title: Work experience
responsibilities: Developed and maintained backend features with Node.js and Express using an organized architecture of models, services, controllers, and DTOs.
Developed and refined frontend interfaces with React and Material UI (MUI), improving visual presentation, themes, and responsive behavior across screen sizes.
Documented REST APIs with Swagger, including endpoints and technical documentation to support system understanding and maintenance.
achievements: Improved application performance, architecture, and maintainability by implementing SOLID principles.
Documented REST API endpoints and services using Swagger.
Developed modules for link management, surveys, and forms.
Implemented Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) with Joi validation to ensure data consistency, enforce input validation, and improve API reliability.

Designed and developed interactive automation widgets, including calculators, dynamic tables, and productivity tools, streamlining advisors' workflows, simplifying complex calculations, and improving operational efficiency.

items.name: Analytics dashboard
items.shortDescription: An analytics dashboard for exploring key metrics and trends visually.
items.description: This dashboard concept organizes key metrics into cards, charts, and tables to make product activity easier to read. The proposal focuses on clear visual hierarchy and reusable components that could adapt to different datasets and analysis needs.

items.description: This task manager concept helps users review pending work, identify priorities, and track each task from a simple interface. Its design includes list and mobile views to keep information organized and make everyday progress easier to follow.
